purpose: Determine whether the external R4/R3 transfer result survives valid-pixel constraints (0<=x_i<=1), or whether SAT witnesses are artifacts of composed regions leaving the image cube.
anchors: SAME 20 held-out test anchors, targets, and train-only calibration as external_mnistfc_strong_transfer_protocol_manifest.json (loaded from external_mnistfc_anchor_baseline.json; unchanged)

regions.R1: pixel ball eps in {0.03,0.05} (reused from external_mnistfc_r1_r2_results.json)
regions.R4: local PCA alpha in {1,2,3} (reused from external_mnistfc_r4_results.json)
regions.R4_bounded: local PCA alpha in {1,2,3} with 0<=reconstructed x_i<=1 enforced (NEW)
regions.R3_bounded: class-AE latent box with 0<=decoded x_i<=1 enforced (NEW)

bounded_encoding: composed ONNX outputs concatenate-by-two-outputs [pixels(784), logits(10)]; Marabou maps Y_0..783=pixels, Y_784..793=logits (Concat is unsupported by Marabou, so two graph outputs are used and the index order is verified by a confusion-only sanity query). VNN-LIB imposes z/latent-box on inputs, 0<=Y_i<=1 for i in 0..783, and Y_{784+target}>=Y_{784+true}.
witness_policy: raw verifier inputs scored; reconstructed pixels NOT clipped; validity in [0,1] reported.
solver: Marabou 2.0 CLI, SnC 4 workers, 120 s per query, exact status parsing
